notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-wizard (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): a three-screen wizard, name step (PCWIZ): MAPFAIL, CLEAR, PF3, the PF7 back-arrow arriving by XCTL. Each scenario is one task; the crucible's multi-turn flows are restated one scenario per leg, each carrying the COMMAREA or channel the previous leg returned. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: pf3-cancel
scenarios.why: PF3 on the name screen: the wizard is cancelled before any RECEIVE MAP

scenarios.name: back-from-confirm
scenarios.why: PC-BACK Y (set by PCCONF's PF7 XCTL): the amount screen is redrawn with CHANGE THE AMOUNT and the kept amount

scenarios.name: back-amount-zero
scenarios.why: PC-BACK Y with a zero amount: the amount screen is redrawn without an amount

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: the name screen is redrawn with SCREEN RESTORED, no RECEIVE

scenarios.name: name-ok
scenarios.why: a name typed: the amount screen follows

scenarios.name: name-mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with nothing typed: RECEIVE MAP gets MAPFAIL, the error is counted and the name screen redrawn

scenarios.name: other-key-takes-name
scenarios.why: PF5 (not PF3 or CLEAR) falls to WHEN OTHER: the name is taken as on ENTER
